:::{#exr-sum-dot-ones-practice}
#### Summing entries with a dot product against the ones vector

Software that computes [dot products](#def-dot-product) quickly
can total the entries of a vector through @thm-sum-dot-ones.
Let

$$
\vx = \sbmat{4 \\ -2 \\ 7 \\ 1},
$$

and let $\v1$ be the [ones vector](#def-ones-vector) with $4$ entries.

Find $\v1 \cdot \vx$.

::: {.callout-tip}
#### Hint

By @thm-sum-dot-ones,
$\v1 \cdot \vx$ is the [sum of the elements](#def-sum-of-elements) of $\vx$.

:::

:::
